dialogues.speaker: Manua
dialogues.text: Hello, hello. I am Manua, the assistant to our chief. Hopefully she hasn't caused you any trouble...

dialogues.speaker: Manua
dialogues.text: Don't get me wrong, Amina is very reliable, and she's learned much in the ways of managing the tribe from her grandfather. I have only the fullest of faith in her potential.

dialogues.speaker: Manua
dialogues.text: But she is still young, and children are bound to miss some details from time to time, so please bear with her.
